question: Is AuroraPIC's matched-half-step promotion deficit caused by reduced supply into the 11.5--15.8 eV band, reduced mover work per band electron, or reduced conversion from the band across 15.8 eV?

basis.observed_before_declaration: The accepted matched-half-step promotion deficit is strongest over x/L=0.2--0.4 and RF phase 0.25--0.375, where two AuroraPIC/native promotion-rate ratios are 0.7549 and 0.7916. No native or AuroraPIC production-state promotion-band work output exists.
basis.smoke_record: The native one-cycle passivity smoke and AuroraPIC unit tests were observed before this rule; they establish only diagnostic correctness and resource behavior.

derived_metrics.band_supply_fraction: promotion-band observations divided by all field-push observations in the critical scope
derived_metrics.band_promotion_probability: promotion-band promotions divided by promotion-band observations
derived_metrics.mean_signed_work_eV: signed macro work sum divided by promotion-band observations
derived_metrics.mean_positive_work_eV: positive macro work sum divided by promotion-band observations
derived_metrics.mean_negative_work_eV: negative macro work sum divided by promotion-band observations

prospective_decision_rule.band_supply_deficit_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native band-supply-fraction ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.positive_work_deficit_supported_if: both AuroraPIC/native mean-positive-work ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.promotion_conversion_deficit_supported_i: both AuroraPIC/native band-promotion-probability ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.aurorapic_repeatability_gate: relative range no greater than 0.10 for supply fraction, promotion probability, and mean positive work
prospective_decision_rule.native_repeatability_gate: relative three-seed range no greater than 0.15 for supply fraction, promotion probability, and mean positive work

claim_boundary: This prospective comparison isolates near-threshold mover work in one matched argon CCP across independently evolved microstates. It does not identify the first self-consistent field divergence, compare experiment, establish a published benchmark pass, or prove general PIC correctness.
